camel_example: aliyun dms ListAgenticDataSources --region cn-hangzhou --InstanceSource RDS --NextToken 'page-2-token' --State 0 --Port 3306 --Schema postgres --MaxResults 20 --SearchKey demo --Host 'mysql.example.com' --DbType MYSQL --version 2025-04-14 --method POST --force
description_en: Performs a paged query on the data sources of the current account by using paging
description_zh: 分页查询当前账号下的数据源
kebab_example: aliyun dms list-agentic-data-sources --db-type MYSQL --state 0 --host mysql.example.com --port 3306 --instance-source RDS --schema postgres --search-key demo --next-token page-2-token --max-results 20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListAgenticDataSources

parameters.help_en: Filters data sources by type. If you leave this parameter empty, no restriction is applied. Valid values: MYSQL, POSTGRESQL, ORACLE, SQLSERVER, MARIADB, POLARDB, POLARDB_POSTGRESQL, POLARDB_ORACLE, OCEANBASEX, DRDS, ADB_MYSQL, ADB_POSTGRESQL, CLICKHOUSE, SELECTDB, STARROCKS, HOLOGRES, MAXCOMPUTE, ES_REST, and TRINO
parameters.help_zh: 按数据源类型精确筛选，不填则不限制类型。当前支持：MYSQL、POSTGRESQL、ORACLE、SQLSERVER、MARIADB、POLARDB、POLARDB_POSTGRESQL、POLARDB_ORACLE、OCEANBASEX、DRDS、ADB_MYSQL、ADB_POSTGRESQL、CLICKHOUSE、SELECTDB、STARROCKS、HOLOGRES、MAXCOMPUTE、ES_REST、TRINO
parameters.name: db_type

parameters.help_en:
Filters data sources by status. If you leave this parameter empty, no restriction is applied. Valid values:
0: normal
-1: deleted
-2: disabled
parameters.help_zh: 按数据源状态精确筛选：0-正常，-1-已删除，-2-已禁用；不填则不限制状态
parameters.name: state

parameters.help_en: Filters data sources by endpoint. If you leave this parameter empty, no restriction is applied
parameters.help_zh: 按连接地址精确筛选；不填则不限制
parameters.name: host

parameters.help_en: Filters data sources by connection port. If you leave this parameter empty, no restriction is applied
parameters.help_zh: 按连接端口精确筛选；不填则不限制
parameters.name: port

parameters.help_en:
Filters data sources by source. If you leave this parameter empty, no restriction is applied. Valid values:
RDS: ApsaraDB instance
PUBLIC_OWN: self-managed database on the public network
ECS_OWN: self-managed database on an ECS instance
GATEWAY: connected through Database Gateway
VPC_IDC: connected over a VPC or IDC
parameters.help_zh: 按数据源来源精确筛选，不填则不限制。取值：RDS-云数据库实例，PUBLIC_OWN-公网自建数据库，ECS_OWN-ECS 自建数据库，GATEWAY-通过数据库网关接入，VPC_IDC-专有网络或 IDC 接入
parameters.name: instance_source

parameters.help_en: Filters data sources by connection target name. The meaning of this parameter varies based on the data source type. If you leave this parameter empty, no restriction is applied
parameters.help_zh: 按连接目标名称精确筛选；其含义随数据源类型变化，不填则不限制
parameters.name: schema

parameters.help_en: Performs a fuzzy search by data source name or endpoint. If you leave this parameter empty, no fuzzy search is performed
parameters.help_zh: 按数据源名称或连接地址模糊搜索；不填则不进行模糊搜索
parameters.name: search_key

parameters.help_en: The pagination cursor. Leave this parameter empty when you query the first page. When you query subsequent pages, pass the NextToken value returned from the previous request
parameters.help_zh: 分页游标；查询第一页时不填，查询后续页面时原样传入上次返回的 NextToken
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return per page. Default value: 20. Maximum value: 200
parameters.help_zh: 每页返回数量；默认 20，最大 200
parameters.name: max_results

Data.description_en: The data sources on the current page

Alias.description_en: The display name of the data source

AuthAccount.description_en: The logon username of the data source. This parameter is empty if username authentication is not used
AuthAccount.description_zh: 数据源登录用户名；未使用用户名认证时为空

AuthPassword.description_en: The masked value of the password or token. The actual value is not returned
AuthPassword.description_zh: 密码或令牌的脱敏值，不会返回真实内容

AuthType.description_en:
The authentication method. Valid values:
-1: no authentication required
0: username and password
1: password only
2: password-free
AuthType.description_zh: 认证方式：-1-无需认证，0-用户名和密码，1-仅密码，2-免密

CatalogName.description_en: The name of the metadata catalog associated with the data source
CatalogName.description_zh: 数据源关联的元数据目录（Catalog）名称

CatalogUuid.description_en: The UUID of the metadata catalog associated with the data source
CatalogUuid.description_zh: 数据源关联的元数据目录 UUID

DataSourceUuid.description_en: The unique identifier of the data source

DbType.description_en: The data source type. Valid values: MYSQL, POSTGRESQL, ORACLE, SQLSERVER, MARIADB, POLARDB, POLARDB_POSTGRESQL, POLARDB_ORACLE, OCEANBASEX, DRDS, ADB_MYSQL, ADB_POSTGRESQL, CLICKHOUSE, SELECTDB, STARROCKS, HOLOGRES, MAXCOMPUTE, ES_REST, and TRINO

EnvType.description_en: The environment type. Valid values: product, pre, dev, test, sit, uat, pet, and stag

GmtCreate.description_en: The time when the data source was created. The time is in the yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss format
GmtCreate.description_zh: 数据源创建时间，格式为 yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss

GmtModified.description_en: The time when the data source was last modified. The time is in the yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss format
GmtModified.description_zh: 数据源最后修改时间，格式为 yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss

Host.description_en: The endpoint of the data source. A masked value may be returned in sensitive scenarios
Host.description_zh: 数据源连接地址；敏感场景可能返回脱敏值

InstanceResourceId.description_en: The ID of the cloud resource instance. This parameter may be empty for data sources registered by endpoint
InstanceResourceId.description_zh: 云资源实例 ID；按连接地址录入的数据源可能为空

InstanceSource.description_en:
The source of the data source. Valid values:
RDS: ApsaraDB instance
PUBLIC_OWN: self-managed database on the public network
ECS_OWN: self-managed database on an ECS instance
GATEWAY: connected through Database Gateway
VPC_IDC: connected over a VPC or IDC
InstanceSource.description_zh: 数据源来源。取值：RDS-云数据库实例，PUBLIC_OWN-公网自建数据库，ECS_OWN-ECS 自建数据库，GATEWAY-通过数据库网关接入，VPC_IDC-专有网络或 IDC 接入

KmsSecret.description_en: The name of the KMS managed credential. This parameter is empty if KMS is not used. This is sensitive information
KmsSecret.description_zh: KMS 托管凭据名称；未使用 KMS 时为空，属于敏感信息

Port.description_en: The connection port of the data source

RegionId.description_en: The region where the data source resides

ResourceAccountId.description_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account to which the resource belongs
ResourceAccountId.description_zh: 资源所属的阿里云主账号 ID

RoleArn.description_en: The ARN of the RAM role used to access the data source. This parameter is empty if role authorization is not used
RoleArn.description_zh: 访问数据源使用的阿里云 RAM 角色 ARN；未使用角色授权时为空

Schema.description_en: The connection target name. For ADB_POSTGRESQL, DRDS, POSTGRESQL, and POLARDB_POSTGRESQL, this parameter indicates the database name. For ORACLE, this parameter indicates the SID or service name. For POLARDB_ORACLE, this parameter indicates the SID. For MAXCOMPUTE, this parameter indicates the project. For other types, this parameter is usually empty
Schema.description_zh: 连接目标名称。ADB_POSTGRESQL、DRDS、POSTGRESQL、POLARDB_POSTGRESQL 表示数据库名；ORACLE 表示 SID 或服务名；POLARDB_ORACLE 表示 SID；MAXCOMPUTE 表示 Project；其他类型通常为空

State.description_en:
The status of the data source. Valid values:
0: normal
-1: deleted
-2: disabled
State.description_zh: 数据源状态：0-正常，-1-已删除，-2-已禁用

SyncAlias.description_en:
Specifies whether to use the cloud instance name as the data source name. Valid values:
1: yes
0: no
SyncAlias.description_zh: 是否使用云端实例名称作为数据源名称：1-是，0-否

UseSsl.description_en:
The SSL settings. Valid values:
1: enabled
0: disabled
-1: default settings
UseSsl.description_zh: SSL 设置：1-启用，0-关闭，-1-使用默认设置

ErrorCode.description_en: The error code returned when the call fails. This parameter is empty if the call is successful
ErrorCode.description_zh: 调用失败时返回的错误码；成功时为空

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned when the call fails. This parameter is empty if the call is successful
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 调用失败时返回的错误信息；成功时为空

MaxResults.description_en: The actual number of entries returned per page in this query
MaxResults.description_zh: 本次查询实际采用的每页数量

NextToken.description_en: The cursor for the next page. An empty value indicates that no more pages are available
NextToken.description_zh: 下一页游标；为空表示没有下一页

RequestId.description_zh: 请求 ID，用于定位本次调用

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the call was successful

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of data sources that meet the filter conditions. This parameter may be empty in some scenarios
TotalCount.description_zh: 符合条件的数据源总数；部分场景可能为空
